label: Странно
description: A 10-sentence usage card for странно (strangely, that's odd).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Manner of action. 'Странно' modifies 'посмотрел', describing an odd, puzzling look. Before the verb, it colours how the glance felt to the speaker.

missions.phrase: Странно, что его до сих пор нет.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Impersonal predicative. Here 'странно' is the predicate meaning 'it is strange', evaluating the fact in the 'что' clause. There is no subject, only the speaker's reaction.
Strategic focus: Manner with verb of perception. 'Странно' modifies 'звучит', meaning it sounds odd. The intensifier 'очень' raises the degree of strangeness.

missions.phrase: Как странно, я этого не помню.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Exclamatory reaction. 'Как странно' is an idiomatic exclamation meaning 'how strange', expressing surprise at one's own lapse. The 'как' intensifies the predicative.
Strategic focus: Odd behaviour. 'Странно' modifies the phrase 'себя ведёт', meaning she is acting oddly. This is the standard way to describe unusual conduct.
Strategic focus: Impersonal feeling. 'Странно' is a predicative paired with the dative 'мне', meaning 'I feel strange inside'. The dative names who experiences the odd mood.
Strategic focus: Manner with smell. 'Странно' modifies 'пахнет', meaning the soup smells odd. The adverb often accompanies verbs of perception to flag something off.
Strategic focus: Parenthetical comment. 'Странно' opens as a one-word aside, meaning 'oddly enough', followed by 'но' for contrast. It frames the speaker's own surprising admission.
Strategic focus: Modifying a participle. 'Странно' modifies 'одет', meaning he is dressed oddly for the occasion. The adverb judges the appropriateness of his appearance.

Strategic focus: Predicative with infinitive. 'Странно' is the impersonal predicate governing the infinitive 'слышать', meaning it is strange to hear this. The construction expresses mild astonishment.
